name: Text 59
text: API state mapping is in speaker notes. Terminal states: REJECTED, FAILED, CANCELLED.

Walk through report submission, three model stages, deterministic test execution, review, and the human gate. The current API state path is QUEUED → RUNNING → TRIAGING → TRIAGED → INVESTIGATING → PATCHED → SANDBOX_RUNNING → SANDBOX_TESTED → REVIEWING → AWAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL → APPROVED → APPLIED → COMMITTED. REJECTED, FAILED and CANCELLED are terminal outcomes. RECEIVED, INVESTIGATED and REVIEWED remain declared compatibility states but are not emitted by the main pipeline path. PR_CREATED and RESOLVED are not pipeline statuses; a GitHub PR is a separately audited action after approval and commit.

name: Text 45

Actual pipeline roles: three model-backed calls (Stage A triage, Stage B combined investigation and patch generation, Stage C review), one deterministic sandbox test runner, and a human operator. The orchestrator is deterministic workflow code, not a model specialist. Three model stages emit validated structured output.

Current architecture: React/Vite dashboard, FastAPI, durable worker/SQLite, Gemini provider, Docker sandbox, three model stages, and optional Switch outbound notifier. Optional GitHub adapter reads configured repository metadata/files and opens a PR only for an approved/committed task after exact remote base/head SHA checks. The commit must already be on the published branch; branch publication is operator-controlled. Relay does not push, merge or deploy.

name: Text 32
text: Live room delivery requires an owner-provisioned agent key and approved room settings.

This slide illustrates optional outbound Switch status updates; the app does not start a task from an inbound Switch message. The official Switch agent protocol documents POST /agents/{agent_id}/message with an agent API key and {room_id, content} body; its incoming room events use a distinct WebSocket protocol. Relay uses only the outbound message route. Sources: https://docs.switchagents.ai/switch-rooms/internals/agent-protocol and https://docs.switchagents.ai/switch-rooms/internals/life-of-a-message.

Production sandbox execution fails closed without Docker isolation. Apply requires an approved task and an explicitly allow-listed target; commit follows as a separate human action. The optional GitHub adapter opens a PR only after approval and commit, and verifies exact base/head revisions against task provenance. The head branch must already be published. Relay does not push, merge, or deploy.
